# Javadoc: arguments package (generated by generate-args.sh)

Difficulty: Medium

Depends on: 003. Conventions: `.todo/javadoc-conventions.md` (see "Generated sources").

Shares `scripts/generate-args.sh` with 012. This todo owns only the heredoc templates listed below; 012 owns the builder templates. Edits stay inside the owned templates so that rebases merge cleanly.

## Owned

- `scripts/generate-args.sh` templates for: `Arguments${i}`, `Arguments${i}Validator`, `DefaultArguments${i}Validator`, `Arguments${i}Splitting`, `Arguments${i}Combining`, `ArgumentsValidators` (all except the two `builder/` outputs)
- Their regenerated outputs in `M/arguments/`
- Hand-written: `M/arguments/Arguments.java`, `M/arguments/package-info.java` (overview: argument tuples, `ArgumentsNValidator`, splitting vs combining, `ArgumentsValidators`, typed validators)

Generated javadoc must read well for every N; avoid text that only holds for N=1 or N=16.

Doclint regex: `am/ik/yavi/arguments/(Arguments\d*|Arguments\d+(Validator|Splitting|Combining)|DefaultArguments\d+Validator|ArgumentsValidators|package-info)\.java`
